reports.notes:
EFI's trenching crew continues excavating for the 6-inch recirculation line, starting from the north lagoon.
- Excavation around the existing 10-inch biogas line will be challenging due to the line being approximately 6 feet deep.
- There are concerns that EFI does not have the appropriate equipment to complete the excavation efficiently.
- I recommended having Bennett take over the 10-inch biogas line excavation since they have a large excavator and hydro-vac equipment available.
- Bennett could potentially complete this excavation in approximately one day.
- Stephen from EFI disagreed with the recommendation and plans to be on-site tomorrow to assess the excavation conditions and equipment requirements.
-The rotameter panel has not arrived on-site.
- The biogas analyzer has not arrived on-site.
